jobs.title: Founding Content Strategist
jobs.description:
Meet Siena

Siena is the Agent of Record for CX, built for consumer brands like Spanx, FIGS, Brooklinen, and Grüns.

It runs as a connected multi-agent stack on top of a shared intelligence layer: agents that sell, support, listen, handle social and voice across the entire customer journey, turning every conversation into signal you can act on.

The team

We are a small, fully distributed, global team. We have built leverage into how we work, which is what lets a team this size move at the speed we do.

We hire athletes. Everyone here owns real outcomes, defaults to writing over meetings, communicates with directness, and acts the moment they see something worth acting on. Low ego, high standards, fast clock.

If you want to set the bar rather than follow one, keep reading.

The Role

Siena is shipping faster than the market can absorb, and the words are not keeping up. The market learns about what we build too late, and when it does, the writing doesn't do the product justice. Today launch content is written by the founders and the growth team between everything else, and nobody owns it.

With several product launches back to back over the next two quarters and a Founding Creative Director coming in to own the visuals, we need one person who owns every word Siena puts in front of the market: founder-led LinkedIn, the company voice on socials, launches, blog posts, announcements, the scripts behind our videos.

You decide what we say, where, and how often, and then you write it. There is no content team underneath you and no copywriters to hand things to. You make the thing.

What You'll Do

You own all of Siena's content: if it goes out under the Siena name and the market reads it, you wrote it or you signed off on it.
You set the strategy for founder-led LinkedIn and the company's own social accounts, write the posts, and own what they do.
You ship every product launch with its words ready, announcement, blog, social sequence and founder posts, working with the Creative Director so the words and the visuals land as one thing.
You write the scripts for every product video and marketing video, from the launch film to a 30-second product clip, and the Creative Director brings them to screen.
You study trends and top performing posts, in our category and outside it, and turn that into a point of view the team can act on, not a swipe file.
You know which content moved something, why, and where to double down, and you kill what doesn't work without being asked.
You use AI in every part of the work, research, drafting, analysis, distribution, and move faster than a content team would. Your taste is the final filter.

Who You Are

The Bar:
If you're missing any of these, this isn't the role for you.

Published writing you can show across blog posts, launch announcements, social, and video scripts.
You have shipped content as the only writer at a company or brand, with no team or copywriters behind you.
You have worked in eCommerce or marketed to consumer brands and understand how their teams operate.

Strong Signal:
Not dealbreakers, but what separates a good hire from a great one.

You were writing professionally before the current AI tools, and you can tell the difference between a sentence that sounds right and one that's true.
You can point to writing that changed what someone did, e.g. the line that got a head of CX to book the demo, the founder post that got forwarded inside a company, the launch that landed.
You use AI in every part of your work and none of it reads like AI.
You measure your own work and change course on the evidence, not on taste alone.
You have run founder-led or executive content before and can show what it did.

Nice to Have:
Bonus, not required.

CX experience in eCommerce, on the brand side or the vendor side.
You have marketed AI, automation, or customer experience products.

Not a Fit If:

You need a content team or copywriters underneath you to produce output.
You think content strategy is a calendar. A calendar isn't a point of view.
You are anti-AI, or you use AI and ship the first draft. Both are disqualifying.
Your best work happens on a slow, protected timeline. Here it's multiple launches in flight and feedback in hours, not weeks.

Why Siena?

Real ownership. You will own problems, not tasks, with the autonomy to solve them your way and the trust to do it without a manager in your inbox.

Work that ships and matters. What you build reaches real consumer brands fast.

A category we are creating. The Agent of Record is new ground, with unsolved problems and cutting-edge models, not a crowded field to compete in.

A team that respects your judgment. Globally distributed, async-first, low bureaucracy. We hire adults and treat you like one.

Great salary plus equity or stock grants. Own a piece of what you build.

Learning budget. If you are growing, so are we.

AI-fluency by default. Few places will push your work with production AI further or faster.

Our values

The people who thrive here are curious, customer-obsessed, and take ownership without being asked. They fix problems first and explain later. They're direct about feedback - both giving and receiving it - because they care more about getting things right than being polite.

They maintain high standards while moving at startup speed, and they build real relationships with teammates because they know that's how great work gets done. When things get tough, they adapt and keep pushing forward.

Our approach to AI

The people who thrive here treat AI like a natural extension of themselves. They've built their own ecosystem of agents - some for research, others for debugging, writing, analysis, or writing code. They know which AI works best for what problem.

Everyone gets premium accounts (ChatGPT, Claude, Perplexity Pro, Cursor, Lovable) plus a quarterly budget for new tools. But the magic happens in how we share knowledge. Demo days where someone shows off a clever workflows. Slack threads about which model handles a specific use case better. Learning from each other's AI workflows.

At Siena, we're not just looking for people who can do a job. We're looking for people who want to break boundaries, create the future, and reshape industries. If that's you, we look forward to your application.

How We Hire

We use AI-assisted screening tools as part of our hiring process. All decisions are made by humans. You can request a human-only review at talent@siena.cx.

We are committed to a diverse and inclusive workforce and welcome people from all backgrounds, experiences, perspectives, and abilities.

jobs.title: Performance Creative Strategist (all genders)(EN)
jobs.description:
YOUR CREATIVE FIELD

We are looking for a full-time, permanent Performance Creative Strategist to start as soon as possible. We live remote-first, but you have the freedom to choose whether you want to work hybrid or completely on-site due to your proximity to one of our locations (Berlin, Cologne, Hamburg, Munich).

As our new Performance Creative Strategist, you will own one of the most direct levers of growth at Contabo Group, a profitable, fast-growing European cloud infrastructure provider backed by KKR and Oakley Capital. Across Meta, Google Ads, TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube, you will decide which ideas get tested, which assets get built, and which concepts get scaled, giving you real ownership and real impact from day one.

You develop and execute creative strategies for every paid channel we run, translating audience insights and funnel data into sharp, performance-driven briefs. From there, you brief and collaborate closely with designers, copywriters, and video producers to bring those concepts to life, and you build the A/B and multivariate testing frameworks that tell us which ones actually win. You read the numbers behind every creative (CTR, CVR, CPA, ROAS), know when to kill a concept and when to scale it, and turn those insights into channel-specific playbooks the whole team can build on.

Because we operate in B2B cloud infrastructure, this role comes with its own puzzle: turning technical, often complex value propositions into ad concepts people actually stop scrolling for. You stay close to platform updates, algorithm shifts, and creative trends across every channel we use, and translate all of it into a systematic testing framework rather than gut feeling.

You will report directly to our Head of Performance Marketing and work within an international, English-speaking team with a flat hierarchy, where you build creative processes from scratch rather than inheriting a rigid one. As we grow, so does the scope of this role, giving you real visibility and a fast path toward owning creative strategy end to end.

WHAT CONVINCES US

Your personality, paired with:

Senior track record at the intersection of creative and performance, spanning concepts, ad copy, hooks, and visual direction, with real ownership of creative KPIs, not just campaign KPIs
Proven experience acting as the creative bridge between performance marketing and creative or product teams, translating offers, product messaging, and campaign goals into platform-ready assets, and briefing designers, copywriters, and UX/UI colleagues with precise, performance-oriented creative briefs
Hands-on experience producing or closely directing assets for paid social (Meta, TikTok, LinkedIn) and video (YouTube, Reels, TikTok), including adapting technical specs to each platform and format
A strong visual and copy instinct, knowing what stops the scroll and what converts, paired with the ability to write sharp, conversion-driven ad copy from headlines and hooks to CTAs across formats and funnel stages, all backed by solid data analysis
Deep fluency in creative testing methodology, from A/B and multivariate testing to creative fatigue analysis and iteration cycles, along with the ability to read creative performance independently from overall campaign performance (ad strength, creative excellence scores, CTR, CVR) and turn that into actionable internal benchmarks
Audience and persona fluency, applying affinity groups, in market segments, and audience insights to creative decisions for each product line and campaign type
Comfortable managing Google Ads and Meta Ads end to end, including creative setup and optimisation
Fluent English and comfortable working in an international team

Should have:

Genuine enthusiasm for platform trends and continuous creative experimentation, combined with a collaborative communication style that keeps cross-functional stakeholders aligned
A data-driven mindset paired with genuine creative instinct, equally at home in a dashboard and in a brainstorm
Familiarity with affiliate partner creative requirements and specs

Nice to have:

Experience in B2B tech, SaaS, or the wider cloud and hosting industry
A portfolio or reel showcasing past creative work
German language skills or additional European languages, alongside fluent English

We know that you may not currently meet all the requirements. But if you come to us with the right amount of commitment and enthusiasm, we can take off together and make a big difference.

AWESOME PROSPECTS

At Contabo, we are constantly evolving. Our growth creates space for new ideas, ownership, and real impact for people who want to make a difference.

What defines us is trust, direct communication, and an open feedback culture. We believe the best solutions are built together and that everyone has the opportunity to contribute, grow, and leave their own footprint.

Additionally, we offer:

Work the way that fits your life – Remote or hybrid with flexible hours for a healthy work-life balance and the same technical equipment at home as in the office
Experience real freedom – Workation across the EU and in our summer office in Mallorca
Stay active and healthy – Access to EGYM Wellpass and thousands of fitness and wellness facilities
Enjoy exclusive perks – Attractive discounts on many products and services through our corporate benefits program
Recharge your energy – 30 days of vacation plus additional days off on Christmas Eve and New Year’s Eve
Give back – An extra day off to get involved in social activities through our Volunteer Day
Make an impact – Take ownership and bring your ideas to life with real creative freedom
Keep growing – Individual professional and personal development opportunities in an innovative tech environment
Feel comfortable where you work – Modern, conveniently located offices across our European locations
Be part of a diverse team – Work in an international environment shaped by diversity
Create lasting memories – Company events and team activities you won’t forget

HOW TO REACH US

If you have any questions, you can reach out to Lisa by email at lisa.bretzel@contabo.de.

ABOUT US

Contabo - High-quality Cloud Hosting Made in Germany!

As a leading infrastructure service provider in the field of cloud instances and dedicated servers, we have stood for first-class quality, reliability and favorable prices since our foundation in Munich in 2003. Meanwhile, more than 300,000 customers in over 190 countries trust our services.

We specialize in providing German quality to users worldwide, focusing on the stability and security of our data centers, the optimization of internal processes, and excellent customer support.

Become a part of our future-oriented company, which plays a significant role in the development of digital cloud hosting, and support us with your ideas and commitment.

AI Case Leads is looking for an experienced, self-directed Senior Creative Strategist to lead the ideation, briefing, and testing of paid media creative across our legal advertising accounts.
We are a performance marketing agency that helps law firms acquire signed retainers. In this role, you will develop creative angles, write detailed production briefs, direct our video editors and content team, and use performance data to determine which concepts should be scaled, improved, or replaced.
This position focuses on creative strategy and day-to-day creative direction. It does not include hiring, personnel management, or media buying responsibilities.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop new advertising concepts, hooks, and creative angles each week.
• Decide which concepts should be produced, scaled, improved, or replaced.
• Research competitor advertising and relevant industry trends.
• Ensure concepts comply with Meta advertising policies and legal advertising requirements before production.
• Write detailed production briefs covering hooks, structure, pacing, copy, calls to action, and visual direction.
• Write scripts and develop storyboards for video and creator-led content.
• Provide day-to-day creative direction to video editors and the content team.
• Review completed assets and provide clear, actionable written feedback.
• Plan and execute creative tests across hooks, formats, and messaging angles.
• Analyze creative performance using metrics such as hook rate, click-through rate, cost per lead, and cost per signed retainer.
• Collaborate with the media buyer on weekly planning and creative decisions.
• Maintain an organized library of tested angles, hooks, spend, and performance results.

Required Qualifications

• Four or more years of experience in creative strategy within a performance marketing agency or in-house performance team.
• Proven experience writing production briefs for video editors and designers.
• Strong understanding of creative performance metrics, including hook rate, CTR, CPL, and cost per acquisition or signed retainer.
• Excellent English communication and copywriting skills, with the ability to write natural, conversational hooks.
• Working knowledge of Meta advertising policies.
• Experience directing UGC creators or influencers.
• Familiarity with Meta Ads Manager, Notion, and Slack.
• Strong organizational skills and the ability to meet deadlines without constant follow-up.
• Full-time availability. This position cannot be combined with other client engagements.

What Success Looks Like

• Production briefs are delivered on schedule, and editors consistently have clear direction.
• New creative concepts are tested every week, with results properly documented.
• Cost per acquisition improves over time.
• The creative library remains current and clearly shows what has been tested and the results produced.
• Potential compliance issues are identified before production rather than after an ad is rejected.
• The co-founder can step away from day-to-day creative direction.

Work Environment

Remote, full-time position.

About us

We are Dragons, a global creative agency working with bold brands to build cultural relevance, connection, and long-term impact through strategy-led creativity.

We're looking for a Creative Director with strong ideas, great visual taste and a real understanding of Spanish culture and consumers, combined with solid international experience.

This person will work primarily across brands and projects with a strong focus on the Spanish market, spanning food, lifestyle, FMCG and other consumer categories.

As Creative Director, you'll lead creative development across brands, from campaign platforms and launches to social, activations, partnerships, content and brand experiences.

The work can vary significantly from brief to brief. One project might require a big emotional campaign for a household brand. Another might be a food or lifestyle launch that needs to feel desirable and contemporary. Another might start with a global platform that requires a strong local expression rather than simply a translated headline.

You'll work closely with Strategy, Copy, Art Direction, Social and Production teams to develop work that is culturally relevant, visually strong and commercially effective.

Develop strong campaign ideas and creative platforms for Spanish and international consumer brands.

Partner closely with Strategy to understand audiences, behaviors and cultural insights, and turn them into creative opportunities.

Develop original campaigns for the Spanish market, as well as local expressions of global brand platforms.

Lead, inspire and develop multidisciplinary creative teams.

Strong conceptual thinking and creative problem-solving skills.

Ability to identify the bigger creative opportunity behind a brief and transform it into a compelling campaign platform, not just an execution.

Experience leading multidisciplinary creative teams and collaborating closely with strategists.

Strong understanding of the Spanish market, its consumers, language, humor and cultural nuances.

Ability to develop authentic, culturally relevant work that resonates locally.

International Perspective

Experience working with global brands, international clients or multicultural teams.

Strong understanding of when a global idea can translate naturally, when it needs adaptation and when a market requires a locally originated solution.

Ability to balance product storytelling with brand-building, creating work that is both commercially effective and culturally engaging.

Understanding of how brands can participate in culture through talent, creators, partnerships, experiences and social channels.

jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken's Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, static and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

The opportunity

As our Senior Performance Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid creative for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Paid static is the center of the role,
but we're hiring a hybrid rather than a specialist: this means you also ideate and create performance video and treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and automation leadership: you set the bar for paid static on the team, work with AI enabled processes, collaborate closely with other Krakenites in and outside the team, and are the person others come to with performance creative questions.

Own paid static for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.
Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform's specs and native feel.
Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets, from 9:16 sound-on to static-adjacent 1:1 and 4:5.
Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video and imagery, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn't.
Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.
Version and localize at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you'll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets.
Build creative that's designed to be tested. Performance Marketing owns test design, cadence and readouts. You own the creative response: reading the results, forming a point of view on why a variant won, and turning that into the next round of hooks, concepts and cuts.
Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.
Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on.

What You’ll Bring

5+ years in performance creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.
A portfolio that proves it, submitted with your application. Paid static above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you're able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed.
Layout, hierarchy, type and composition that hold up at thumbnail size, in feed, and in multiple languages.
Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.
Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut.
High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it.
Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You're fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision.
Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic timing and an instinct for what's about to feel dated.
Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.
Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with layouts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements.
A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.
Figma and Adobe CC (After Effects, Premiere, Photoshop) as well as strong genAI skills
Curious about investing and crypto at a minimum, and able to make the space legible to others.

Scopely is looking for a Production Director – Seasonal Content to join our MONOPOLY GO! team. This role can be based remotely in the UK or from our Barcelona hub on a hybrid basis.

MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide.

At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and strive to inspire play every day—whether through our work alongside exceptional teammates or through unforgettable experiences for millions of players. We're a global team of game makers building one of the world's most successful live-service games.

As the Production Director – Seasonal Content, you'll own the operational health, planning, and execution behind MONOPOLY GO!'s seasonal content portfolio. You'll partner across Art, Design, Product, Live Operations, Licensing, and Content teams to ensure every season delivers exceptional quality, creative novelty, operational excellence, and measurable player impact.

Success in this role goes beyond shipping content on schedule. You'll be accountable for the health of the seasonal ecosystem—including content capacity, creative ambition, production predictability, IP integration, execution quality, and the cross-functional alignment required to consistently deliver industry-leading live-service seasons.

This role requires an exceptional balance of strategic leadership and tactical execution. You'll be equally comfortable shaping long-term organizational strategy with senior leadership as you are rolling up your sleeves with producers, artists, designers, and engineers to solve production challenges, unblock teams, and improve execution day-to-day.

What You'll Do

Lead production for the Seasonal Content organization, overseeing the planning, execution, and successful delivery of every MONOPOLY GO! season.
Own the operational health of the seasonal portfolio, balancing player experience, content quality, novelty, production predictability, resource utilization, and business objectives—not simply delivery against schedule.
Drive the long-term evolution of the seasonal content pipeline, continuously improving how art, design, narrative, gameplay content, rewards, licensed IP, localization, and live operations move from concept through launch.
Own content roadmap planning, art capacity planning, outsourcing strategy, and resource forecasting to maximize both creative ambition and sustainable execution.
Partner closely with Product, Art, Design, Live Operations, Marketing, and Licensing leadership to align priorities across multiple concurrent seasonal initiatives.
Operate comfortably at both the executive and production floor levels—providing strategic direction while remaining actively involved in milestone reviews, dependency management, issue resolution, production planning, and critical decision making.
Be willing to get "in the weeds" with producers and development teams to remove blockers, resolve ambiguity, improve workflows, and ensure teams have what they need to succeed.
Lead cross-functional planning for major seasonal launches, proactively identifying execution risks, staffing challenges, dependency conflicts, and operational gaps before they impact delivery.
Drive executive-level visibility through clear reporting, production health metrics, risk assessments, and actionable recommendations.
Champion continuous improvement across production methodologies, governance, tooling, AI adoption, and content development workflows.
Lead organizational change initiatives that improve how teams plan, collaborate, and execute, ensuring new processes are successfully adopted across multiple disciplines.
Serve as a diplomatic leader who builds trust across diverse teams, navigates competing priorities with empathy, and facilitates alignment during high-pressure or ambiguous situations.
Mentor Production Managers and Producers while raising the overall maturity and effectiveness of production across the Seasonal Content organization.

What We're Looking For

Extensive experience leading production within large-scale live-service game development environments.
Deep expertise managing content-heavy production pipelines, including art production, outsourcing, IP development, localization, approvals, and live seasonal releases.
Demonstrated success operating as a Production Director or equivalent leader responsible for both organizational strategy and execution.
Proven ability to seamlessly shift between strategic leadership and hands-on production management, remaining deeply connected to execution while guiding long-term organizational direction.
Strong expertise in production planning, capacity planning, portfolio management, dependency mapping, forecasting, and operational excellence.
Exceptional understanding of creative development pipelines and how to optimize art and content production without sacrificing quality or innovation.
Outstanding diplomacy and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to influence senior leaders, resolve conflict constructively, and build alignment across diverse disciplines without relying on direct authority.
Experience leading organizations through meaningful operational change, including introducing new production processes, organizational structures, tools, or ways of working while driving strong adoption.
Excellent judgment balancing player experience, creative ambition, technical constraints, production risk, and business priorities.
Outstanding communication, organizational leadership, and relationship-building skills.
Comfortable operating in fast-paced environments with rapidly evolving priorities and complex cross-functional organizations.
Passion for building high-performing teams, enabling creative excellence, and delivering unforgettable seasonal experiences at world-class scale.

AI Capability & Readiness

We believe AI will fundamentally transform how content organizations operate. In this role, you'll be expected to actively incorporate AI into production workflows to improve planning, asset tracking, documentation, communication, forecasting, content review, dependency management, and operational decision-making. You'll champion thoughtful AI adoption across the Seasonal Content organization, helping teams work faster, make better decisions, and increase creative capacity without compromising quality. We value leaders who are curious, experimental, and capable of driving organizational change as AI reshapes game development.

Bonus Points

Experience working on category-leading live service games.
Experience within mobile free-to-play game development.
Experience leading globally distributed development teams.
Experience scaling production organizations during periods of rapid growth.
Familiarity with modern AI productivity tools such as Claude, Codex, Cursor, or similar, and experience applying them to production workflows.
Experience evolving production operating models, governance frameworks, or portfolio planning processes.

At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! We are committed to creating a diverse, supportive work environment where everyone is treated with respect. We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities and welcome individuals from all backgrounds to join us & embrace the adventure!

jobs.description:
Building the Future of Open Finance

Payward - the parent company behind Kraken, NinjaTrader, Breakout, xStocks, Payward Services and CF Benchmarks - has spent the last 15 years building one of the most modern and globally accessible financial infrastructure platforms in the industry, built to advance an open, global financial system.

Before you apply, we encourage you to explore our culture page to understand what drives us and how we work.

The team

Founded in 2011, Kraken is one of the world's longest-standing crypto platforms, trusted by over 10 million individuals and institutions across the globe. It offers spot trading, margin, futures, staking, and OTC services, with products built for both individual investors and institutional clients.

Kraken's Consumer Creative & Design team owns end-to-end creative execution for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Our disciplines cover performance ad creative, static and 3D design, motion design, AI video creative and web design, turning growth strategy into creative that converts across paid, owned and organic surfaces. We work closely with Product Marketing, Performance Marketing, Content & Social, Lifecycle and our regional leads, holding the line on brand and messaging quality on everything that ships.

The opportunity

As our Senior Performance Creative, you concept, produce and ship paid creative for Kraken Consumer and Krak. Paid static is the center of the role,
but we're hiring a hybrid rather than a specialist: this means you also ideate and create performance video and treat gen AI as a core production method rather than a novelty. You take a project from idea to a finished, approved, multi-market asset set, and you bring a real feel for what people stop on, share and screenshot.

You report to the Creative Lead, Consumer Creative & Design, who gives you direction, feedback and cover in reviews. This is a senior individual contributor role with no direct reports. Senior here means craft and automation leadership: you set the bar for paid static on the team, work with AI enabled processes, collaborate closely with other Krakenites in and outside the team, and are the person others come to with performance creative questions.

Own paid static for Kraken Consumer across product launches, campaigns, promotions and always-on activity.
Build for channels like Meta, TikTok, YouTube, LinkedIn, Reddit and X. You know what wins where, and you build to each platform's specs and native feel.
Concept and cut performance video so campaigns ship as complete cross-format sets, from 9:16 sound-on to static-adjacent 1:1 and 4:5.
Produce AI-generated and AI-assisted video and imagery, and know when AI is the fastest route to a great ad and when it isn't.
Bring ideas to briefs rather than executing them literally. Pitch culturally timely, internet-native concepts that nobody asked for, and build the winners into creative pillars we can keep using.
Version and localize at scale across markets, languages, formats and regulatory requirements. In a typical month you'll have roughly a dozen workstreams in flight at once, most spanning several formats and several markets.
Build creative that's designed to be tested. Performance Marketing owns test design, cadence and readouts. You own the creative response: reading the results, forming a point of view on why a variant won, and turning that into the next round of hooks, concepts and cuts.
Partner with Product Marketing, compliance and regional teams to get work approved without losing the idea.
Hold a high craft bar on your own work and keep your files clean enough for other people to build on.

What You’ll Bring

5+ years in performance creative at a high-volume in-house team or performance agency, ideally in fintech, crypto, gaming or another regulated category.
A portfolio that proves it, submitted with your application. Paid static above all, with the brief or objective alongside the work and the result where you're able to share it. Include two or three full video cuts, at least one AI-generated or AI-assisted piece with a short note on what was tooling and what was you, and one concept you tested where you can talk us through what the data said and what you changed.
Layout, hierarchy, type and composition that hold up at thumbnail size, in feed, and in multiple languages.
Platform-native instincts across Meta, TikTok and YouTube. You can explain why the same idea needs a different build on each one.
Real video skills, from concept to finished, sound-designed cut.
High-level command of gen AI video and image tooling, with shipped work to show for it.
Experience inside a structured creative testing program. You're fluent in the metrics your creative moves (thumb-stop rate, hook rate, CTR, CVR, CPA and ROAS), you can tell a real winner from low performers, and can translate test results into a creative decision.
Fluency in internet and meme culture, with comedic timing and an instinct for what's about to feel dated.
Speed without sloppiness. Comfortable with fast turnarounds, several review rounds and late changes.
Comfort working inside regulatory constraints, with layouts that survive risk warnings and market-specific requirements.
A solid copywriting instinct. Plain language, value first, no hype and no jargon.
Figma and Adobe CC (After Effects, Premiere, Photoshop) as well as strong genAI skills
Curious about investing and crypto at a minimum, and able to make the space legible to others.

jobs.title: Performance Creative Strategist
jobs.description:
Are you ready to shape the ads that introduce Kit & Kin to thousands of new customers?
Co-founded by Spice Girl Emma Bunton, Kit & Kin is a certified B Corp creating everyday essentials for families, with award-winning baby and cleaning products sold through DTC, Amazon and retail channels.

As we continue to grow, we’re looking for a Performance Creative Strategist to own our paid social creative strategy, track and analyse ad performance, and turn those insights into stronger advertising.
This is an exciting opportunity for someone who combines creative thinking with analytical confidence and wants real ownership, autonomy and impact within a growing ecommerce brand.

THE ROLE:

You’ll take ownership of the creative development and performance analysis behind our paid social advertising, with Meta as your primary focus.

You’ll be accountable for understanding which ads, hooks, messages and formats are working, which are underperforming and what we should do next. You’ll use those findings to develop successful formats further, improve weaker concepts and identify fresh creative opportunities.

Working closely with our Senior Performance Marketing Manager, internal creative team and external creators, you’ll take ideas from customer insight through scripting, briefing, production and testing. You’ll help us make more of our founder, expert, creator and product content across nappies, wipes, skincare and cleaning.

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys writing a compelling script as much as analysing the results. You’ll own creative reporting and recommendations, partnering with performance marketing to translate better creative into more efficient customer acquisition.

RESPONSABILITIES:

Creative performance tracking and analysis

Own our ad creative performance tracker and weekly reporting, clearly identifying what is working, what isn’t and the recommended next steps.
Establish consistent naming and tagging to compare performance by concept, format, hook, message, creator and product.
Analyse CPA, ROAS, conversion rate, click-through rate and video engagement alongside spend to understand commercial outcomes and where ads lose attention.
Investigate results with our Senior Performance Marketing Manager, accounting for differences in audience, placement, offer, landing page and the amount of data available.
Identify emerging winners and signs of creative fatigue, and turn findings into prioritised recommendations and production briefs.

Creative strategy and testing

Own a creative testing roadmap aligned with commercial priorities, product launches, and production capacity.
Define clear hypotheses and agree success measures for each test with performance marketing.
Develop successful formats further through new hooks, scripts, creators, lengths and product angles.
Diagnose underperforming creative and recommend specific improvements, further testing or retirement.
Document results and learnings so each round of creative builds on the last.

Concepts, copy and production

Research customer reviews, surveys, social comments and customer service feedback to uncover motivations, objections and opportunities.
Develop concepts for video, static and carousel ads, including demonstrations, testimonials, founder stories, expert advice and offers.
Work with a copywriter to create compelling hooks, scripts, headlines and calls to action that communicate product benefits clearly in our brand voice.
Brief creators, copywriters, editors and designers with clear direction on the audience, message, opening, footage and intended test.
Plan scripts and shot lists for founder, expert and product shoots, and repurpose existing footage into fresh ads.
Give actionable feedback on storytelling, pacing, visuals and messaging, keeping production moving to agreed deadlines.
Ensure creative follows our product claims and brand guidelines, with appropriate usage permissions confirmed.
Stay informed about competitor advertising, platform developments and emerging formats to identify relevant opportunities.

WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

3+ years’ relevant experience in performance creative strategy, paid social or a related role within an ecommerce brand or agency.
Proven experience developing paid social creative for DTC or ecommerce brands, particularly on Meta.
Hands-on experience using Meta Ads Manager to track, analyse and compare performance at ad level.
A portfolio demonstrating how you have used results to improve creative, with clear examples of your contribution and the impact.

jobs.description:
Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call.

Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data.

We're hiring one person to own content at Soda, end to end.

Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues.

The Role

The website. Technical blogs, webinars, and product videos. Your own content and following.

One person cannot hand-make all of that. So you'll build the system that can. That isn't a stretch goal or a second phase - we don't think the job exists without it.

You'll join the Growth team reporting to a co-founder.

What you might call yourself.
Content engineer, technical content marketer, growth engineer, marketing engineer, GTM engineer, developer advocate, technical writer who got bored, or nothing in particular. We've seen this job posted under every one of those. We don't care what's on your CV. You need to be able to write and you need to be able to build, and almost nobody can do both.

Why this is a real problem and not a content calendar.
The expertise is already in the building. Founders who have argued about this category for a decade. Customer engineers who spend their week inside broken pipelines at Fortune 500s. Customers who will tell you things nobody has published anywhere. Almost none of it gets written down, and what does get out is hand-made, one piece at a time, by people who have other jobs. Your job is to get it out of their heads and onto the internet, at a volume that is only possible with a machine behind it.

Taste is the bar.
Anti-slop is the whole point. An engine that ships slop faster has negative value, and most of them do. We're hiring for the judgment to look at an accurate, competent, lifeless draft and bin it - then work out what the pipeline did wrong and fix it. The engine has to write in distinct voices: a founder sounds nothing like a customer engineer, and the output should sound like them, not like a model. Your own profile and following is part of how we'll know it works. If it can't make you sound good, it won't make anyone else sound good either.

What this is not.
You'll write code every day, but this is not a software engineering job. We're not hiring you to build product, and if you're a backend, data, or platform engineer looking for your next engineering role, this isn't it. It's also not a traditional marketing or DevRel role: no agency to brief and no conference circuit.

Requirements

You can write, and you can tell good writing from bad: send us something you wrote that a technical audience actually read. The most important line in this ad
Serious prompt engineering: multi-step LLM pipelines with structured outputs and evals, not chatting with a model. You know why the naive version produces slop
3+ years building things that go to market: technical content, growth engineering, marketing engineering, GTM engineering, DevRel, marketing ops, RevOps, or a founder background. Nobody agrees what to call this job yet. Titles vary; portfolios don't
Enough code to be autonomous: Python or TypeScript, APIs, webhooks, a database. Nothing should be blocked waiting for an engineer. We build agentically here - Claude Code, MCP servers, and agent skills are the daily workflow
Enough data fluency to be credible: you're writing for Staff Data Engineers and CDOs. You can hold your own on pipelines, data quality, and warehouses
Generalist instinct: you find the constraint and fix it, and you'd rather build the workflow than do the task fifteen more times
Independence: you don't need hand-holding in a distributed, async team across 12+ countries
Fluent English

Good to Have

You've grown a technical audience of your own: newsletter, blog, LinkedIn, open source, YouTube
Content, growth, or DevRel in data, developer tools, or infrastructure
Agentic workflows shipped to real users: MCP servers, Claude skills, tool-using agents
You can shoot and cut video yourself
Data quality, data management, or data observability industry experience

Benefits

Compensation: $120,000-$130,000 / €110,000-€120,000 per year + equity - the same band wherever you live. We don't discount for geography
Fully remote (US or EU-based), with offices in Brooklyn if you want one
All the tokens you need, across all frontier models
Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement
Colleagues in 12+ countries

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it
Ownership from day one: if you see a bottleneck, you remove it
International culture: colleagues in 12+ countries
Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours
Paid the same wherever you are: one band for the US and Europe, no geographic discount
Your name on the work: you build your own audience on company time, and we want you to
Direct line to the founders: how Soda talks about the category gets decided with you in the room

😡 What you might not love

Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done
Flexibility required: you will have to learn new things all the time
You will kill a lot of your own output: accurate and lifeless still goes in the bin
Judged on output, not architecture: an elegant pipeline nobody reads from is a failure

Short Assignment
Craft deep dive (90 min)

At Instructure
, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.

We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

Foundry is a standalone division inside Instructure, built to generate new revenue with AI-built products. You’re the growth engine for the pods. In the core business, this work splits across product marketing, demand generation, content, and lifecycle teams; here, it’s one person doing all of it — finding the message that lands, filling the early-access pipeline, and turning a working product into paying customers. You’ll set positioning, generate demand, and own the funnel from first touch to renewal, working hand in hand with Pod Founders who are selling as they build. This is a blank-page job: most pods start with no category, no audience list, and no playbook, and you’ll build all three. The role reports to the President, Foundry, with a matrixed dotted line to Instructure’s Marketing leadership.

What You’ll Do

Own positioning and messaging. Craft the value proposition, naming, and packaging input for products customers have never heard of, and maintain messaging frameworks by segment across K12, higher education, and business and government.
Run go-to-market and launch. Own go-to-market readiness for pilots, early access, and general availability — timelines, channels, pricing input, and the launch assets that carry the story.
Build the demand engine. Generate pipeline through campaigns, audience building, early-access recruiting, and the top of the funnel that feeds the Founder’s selling.
Drive content. Create the collateral, digital content, and customer-facing assets that build demand and make the differentiation obvious.
Be the market and customer expert. Become the go-to expert on the portfolio’s customers and competitors, and feed that insight back into product and pricing.
Own lifecycle and adoption. Once customers land, drive adoption, expansion, and retention with consistent, value-based messaging.
Measure and adjust. Track funnel and campaign performance against pipeline and revenue, and change course fast when the numbers say so.

What You’ll Need

Five or more years in product, portfolio, or growth marketing, ideally in ed tech or a related industry, with new-product launches under your belt.
A demonstrated ability to drive go-to-market strategy and execute strategic product launches end to end.
Demand-generation range — campaigns, funnel, and audience building — not just positioning and decks.
Strong writing, with a portfolio of strategically focused content and collateral.
The ability to influence executive and cross-functional teams, and to present to groups large and small, virtually and in person.
A full-stack marketer’s range — you do product marketing, demand generation, content, and lifecycle yourself, and you market to fill pipeline and close revenue, not to win awards.

This Role Isn’t For Everyone

You should probably pass if:

You want to own one slice — just messaging, or just campaigns — and hand off the rest.
You need an established brand and a built-in audience to market into. Here you build the category.
You measure success by impressions and activity rather than by pipeline and revenue.
